description: Short real-run smoke for image_gpt (iGPT: generative pretraining from pixels, Chen et al. 2020): pretrain -> encoder.pt + clusters.npy -> linear_eval, one epoch each on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. Unlike the EVAL_DOWNLOAD generative shape, iGPT's probe reads the model this port trains (IGPT.extract_features), so linear_eval consumes the pretrained encoder.pt. It ALSO needs clusters.npy: the colour clusters fit during pretraining, which the probe must quantise images with (the same colour space the model was trained on). encoder.pt threads via @encoder; clusters.npy threads via @produces:clusters.npy -- the first spec to exercise the general artifact-threading the driver grew for exactly this. The iGPT-S recipe (vocab_size 512, img_size 32, n_layer 24, n_head 8, n_embd 512, 300 epochs) is shrunk to the tiny architecture the method's own test exercises on CPU: vocab_size 8, img_size 8, n_layer 2, n_head 2, n_embd 32 -- the real architecture, just small. The same model keys are set in both stages so load_encoder rebuilds the model identically; only the run-length knobs and the tiny-arch dims are overridden.
